{{short description|Theorem connecting algebraic and topological K-theories on C* algebras}}

In [[mathematics]], the '''Karoubi conjecture''' was a conjecture by [[Max Karoubi]] that the  algebraic and topological [[K-theory|K-theories]] coincide on [[C* algebra]]s spatially tensored with the algebra of compact operators.{{sfnp|Karoubi|1979}} It was proved by [[Andrei Suslin]] and [[Mariusz Wodzicki]].{{sfnp|Suslin|Wodzicki|1990|loc=theorem 6}}{{sfnp|Suslin|Wodzicki|1992}}
